requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Left open in an earlier pass as an unrecognized proxy shape - turned out not to be a proxy at all, but Spark’s own ALMProxy dispatcher, gated by the identical executor contract already traced for Spark Savings USDG.
narrative.tag: resolved a real open thread, not repeated
narrative.detail: A DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE replay from genesis confirms one current holder, matched by address AND bytecode size (8,113 bytes) to the exact same executor instance administering Spark Savings USDG - its L1-authenticated governance chain (resolving to Sky/MakerDAO’s own verified "SubProxy") is therefore identical too, re-verified live rather than assumed.

reproduce.note: this RPC cannot replay the block of the build (it ignores the block tag, or no longer serves old state): the call reproduces the current value, not the one of the build; compare the composite and lastUpdated with this page

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.reason: Too few people need to agree

independent_read.why: AccessControl (ERC-165) whose admin-role holders are not enumerable on-chain: read them from RoleGranted events; nothing for this reader to compare
